checks.claim: Every third-party import the test suite and scripts make is installed by requirements.txt
checks.result: fail on main at 06f56c2b, fixed on main by 0427b814 + 6c051a73, pinned here
checks.method: PR #267 (commit d29a5602) added tests/test_b97af12f_reconciliation.py with a module-level `import pytest`, which requirements.txt never declared. `python -m unittest discover -s tests` therefore reported ERROR: test_b97af12f_reconciliation (ImportError: No module named 'pytest') and exited non-zero, so pages.yml's regression step went red and the four-hour refresh died a second time, one commit after the egw_live NameError was fixed. Reproduced locally on a clean worktree of origin/main at 06f56c2b: "Ran 1419 tests ... FAILED (errors=1)". The module was also pytest-style, so unittest collected zero of its six checks. Both halves are fixed on main: 0427b814 declared the dependency and 6c051a73 (owner arena-b97af12f) converted the module to unittest.TestCase. This session pins the contract with tests/test_d202e156_declared_imports.py.
